allowedWork: Work only on the approved composable semantic animation asset v0 loop.
Keep tutorials, cards, exports, flashcards, graphs, and programming views as consumers of animation assets rather than the core artifact.
Commit after each verified slice and record Theseus evidence.
disallowedWork: Do not broadly rename tutorial-card modules in this loop.
Do not add GIF or video encoders in this loop.
Do not add curriculum generation, spaced repetition generation, or dynamic package loading in this loop.
Do not create renderer-owned animation formats separate from semantic asset calculus.
goal: Run the approved KP loop that makes composable semantic animations the primary typed artifact, with tutorials, exports, flashcards, graphs, and programming views as consumers.
